trust_decision.summary: The OAuth client decides whether fetched RFC 9728 protected resource metadata (authorization_servers, scopes_supported) belongs to the MCP server it is connecting to (base_url). At the pinned commit it trusts the metadata without checking the 'resource' field, in AuthorizationManager::discover_oauth_server_via_resource_metadata.

landing_point.why: The summary names protected resource metadata discovery. This is the only function that consumes ResourceServerMetadata, and it sits next to the struct that lacks a resource field (auth.rs:544).

fix_sites.module_kind: deserialization struct in the core OAuth client module
core OAuth client discovery logic (new helpers validate_resource_metadata_resource / resource_identifiers_match / is_root_resource_identifier added after auth.rs:1893)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All callers converge on discover_metadata (auth.rs:1067); the transports in crates/rmcp/src/transport/common/reqwest/streamable_http_client.rs:137 and crates/rmcp/src/transport/common/unix_socket.rs:207 only surface the WWW-Authenticate header as an error and do not parse resource metadata.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is no O2 site or O8 route. The only arguable dismissal is the direct OAuth fallback (auth.rs:1072), which uses no resource metadata (legacy pre-RFC9728 servers), so a solver would rightly leave it alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A root resource identifier without a trailing slash ('http://host') has to keep matching a base_url that Url normalizes to 'http://host/'. The project's own client-credentials integration test serves exactly that shape. Servers that publish no protected resource metadata still fall back to direct AS discovery. An exact-string compare or a 'reject when no PRM' fix breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: root identifier trailing-slash difference in either direction (accepted)

O7_producer.where: Metadata is deserialized directly in fetch_resource_metadata_from_url (crates/rmcp/src/transport/auth.rs:1987) and consumed in the same call chain.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The well-known probe returns its own URL as the metadata URL on 200 and the body is fetched again; a planted cached-body shortcut that parses the 200 body there and skips the shared validation would be a where-type copy.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Avoiding the double GET is a plausible optimization a maintainer would write, but it only costs a search (where-type).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A planted public helper that takes a metadata URL or a ResourceServerMetadata from the caller (like set_metadata) and selects the AS without the resource check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The conformance client and examples already build flows around start_authorization_with_metadata_url and set_metadata (conformance/src/bin/client.rs:245-246), so a lower-level public API is a natural addition.

O9_family: CWE-345 insufficient verification of data authenticity (OAuth protected resource metadata / mix-up)

O10_build.toolchain: cargo (stable Rust, workspace crates/rmcp + crates/rmcp-macros), auth feature
O10_build.project_tests: Unit tests in the mod tests of crates/rmcp/src/transport/auth.rs (RecordingOAuthHttpClient mocks, e.g. auth.rs:3179, auth.rs:3304) plus crates/rmcp/tests/test_client_credentials.rs (local axum mock server).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add resource: Option<String> and reject unless it equals self.base_url.as_str() exactly, which breaks the root trailing-slash case served by test_client_credentials.rs.

out_of_scope_notes: WWW-Authenticate scope is written to www_auth_scopes in fetch_resource_metadata_url (auth.rs:1953) before any metadata validation; not pursued.
